verdict.rationale: Oneleet's docs confirm you can set up and publish a customizable Trust Center and link it from your landing page, so the core hosted public trust center exists. Nothing in the evidence describes what it shows or how documents are gated. Missing for 10: live control status display, certification/framework badges on the trust center, report sharing under click-through NDA, evidence it shortens security reviews, independent or hands-on corroboration.
